questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SENT:

SUBJECT:

 Susan Tucker

Potential Employee

Job Posting

July 20th, 2:30 P.M.
Marketing Specialist Americas – USA

We are searching for a Marketing Specialist to support a Global Marketing Manager to execute strategies for generating new business leads, while building brand recognition. The Marketing Specialist will be a member of the Global Marketing team with primarily responsibility for North America events, media planning, research and analysis of data. Thank you.

Yours truly,

Susan Tucker
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are a job candidate. In your e-mail, describe TWO of your job qualifications and ask ONE question.
questions.model_answer:
Dear Ms. Tucker, Lời chào
Thanks for your letter. I am writing in regards to the marketing specialist position. I firmly believe that I am qualified for the position and hope you will give me a chance to work as a marketing specialist. I have been working as a senior creator related to public relations at BRAND IMAGE, so I know how to build brand recognition matched to specific products. Over the last seven years I have gained experience creating appropriate marketing strategies (trình độ 1). In addition, I am currently taking Japanese classes to improve my language skills, and will receive a certificate in two months (trình độ 2). By the way, I have one question regarding this application. Could you let me know the due date for submitting an actual réumé (câu hỏi)? I hope that we will have a chance to further discuss my qualifications in person. Thank you for your time. - Trình độ công việc: + Đã từng là nhà sáng tạo liên quan tới xây dựng hình ảnh thương hiệu, tôi đã có nhiều kinh nghiệm triển khai các chiến dịch marketing hợp lý. + Biết tiếng Nhật, đang học và sẽ có chứng chỉ trong 2 tháng - Câu hỏi: Hạn chót để gửi hồ sơ là ngày nào?
Sincerely, Nancy William Ký tên

questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SENT:

SUBJECT:

 Rowena Kim

World-Wide Travel

Travel Information

May 10th at 4:20 P.M.
To Whom It May Concern,

 

My name is Rowena Kim and I’m interested in receiving some information about a tour package for this summer holiday. I would like to visit a foreign country, but I don’t have enough information about where I should go. Also, my budget is very limited. If it is possible, could you please send me information about the tour packages you would recommend. Thanks for all your help.

 

Regards,

Rowena Kim
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you were an agent at World-wide Travel agency. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information about tour packages and ONE suggestion.
questions.model_answer:
Dear Rowena Kim, Lời chào
Thank you for your e-mail of the 20th of May asking about available travel packages. We were pleased to hear that you wish to visit a foreign country this summer. Actually, we have some international tours you may be interested in. You have the great chance to book a package tour to Japan for only $200, including accommodations, or to go to Singapore for $280, including a 10% discount on airfare (thông tin 1). Both programs are still available, but we are almost booked solid for June (thông tin 2). I suggest that you should choose your tour package as soon as possible so that we can reserve the tour package you want (gợi ý). We look forward to the pleasure of hearing from you soon. - Thông tin: + Bạn có thể đi tour Nhật Bản giá $200 bao gồm chỗ ở hoặc đi Singapore giá $280 bao gồm giảm giá 10% vé máy bay + 2 tour này đều đang gần kín trong tháng 6 - Câu hỏi: Bạn hãy cho chúng tôi biết lựa chọn của bạn càng sớm càng tốt để chúng tôi đặt tour mà bạn muốn
Sincerely, Tim Dales Ký tên

questions.question: When it comes to workplaces, we normally think we have to go there to work. A lot of us commute to work every day. However, there are some people who work remotely at their homes or away from their offices. What do you think is the reason why some companies permit their employees to work this way?
questions.model_answer:
Mở bài For many years in the past and for most businesses, it has been common sense that people have to commute to their workplaces. However, where we work has been changing. More and more employees are working remotely, sometimes at home. The reasons are to save company expenses and not to have limitation on recruiting talented job seekers. Nêu rõ 2 luận điểm sẽ triển khai: tiết kiệm chi phí cho công ty và không có giới hạn trong việc tuyển dụng
Thân bài 1 (Tiết kiệm chi phí) First of all, companies want to reduce their operating costs. Among the many ways of achieving this goal, having employees work remotely can reduce money spent on office equipment that employees generally need if they have to work in an office. Long ago, I used to work for a company that was located in the city far from where I lived. There was no branch office where I could commute to, but that company wanted me. The only option left for both of us was for me to stay home and work remotely. With the advances in technology, especially the Internet, I was able to work fine a long way from the company. If the company had set up a local office for me, they would have had to spend a large amount of money. - Phân tích: giảm được chi phí vào các thiết bị mà nhân viên cần khi làm ở văn phòng. - Ví dụ: Tôi từng làm việc ở một văn phòng xa nơi tôi sống. Công ty không có chi nhánh nơi tôi có thể đến làm, nhưng công ty đó vẫn muốn tôi làm. Lựa chọn duy nhất là cho tôi ở nhà và làm từ xa. Với sự tiến bộ công nghệ, tôi làm việc rất tốt. Nếu công ty xây dựng một văn phòng địa phương cho tôi, họ sẽ tốn rất nhiều tiền
Thân bài 2 (không giới hạn trong việc tuyển dụng) Second, companies can create more chances to hire qualified and competent employees who live far away from the workplace. Sometimes, engineers in the computer, biotechnology pharmaceutical fields, and so forth, are not easily found locally. What if a high-tech company finds a candidate perfectly suited for its job, but the candidate doesn't want to relocate? Then there is no choice but to let the person work remotely. - Phân tích: có thể tuyển những nhân viên có trình độ và năng lực tốt sống ở xa nơi làm việc. Đôi khi những người tài giỏi rất khó tìm ở địa phương. Nếu công ty công nghệ cao tìm được một ứng viên hoàn toàn phù hợp với công việc nhưng ứng viên không muốn tái định cư để đi làm thì sao? Không có lựa chọn nào khác ngoài cho họ làm từ xa
Kết bài Cost-conscious companies want to save money to increase profits and they want to find qualified employees without worrying about geographical restrictions. To achieve these goals, companies choose to allow their employees to work at home if no other options are available. It seems that working at home or remotely is a growing trend nowadays. Tổng hợp, nhắc lại về 2 luận điểm đã nêu và nói thêm về cảm nghĩ cá nhân.

intro.content:
Question 1-5: Write a sentence based on a picture

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write ONE sentence that is based on a picture. With each picture, you will be given TWO words or phrases that you must use in your sentence. You can change the forms of the words and you can use the words in any order. Your sentences will be scored on

  • the appropriate use of grammar and
  • the relevance of the sentence to the picture

In this part, you can move to the next question by clicking on Next. If you want to return to a previous question, click on Back. You will have 8 minutes to complete this part of the test.

Example

 Sample response: This man is writing in a notebook.

Question 6-7: Respond to a written request

Directions: In this part of the test, you will show how well you can write a response to an e-mail.

Your response will be scored on

  • the quality and variety of your sentence,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 10 minutes to read and answer each e-mail

Click on Continue to go on.

Question 8: Write an opinion essay

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write an essay in response to a question that asks you to state, explain, and support your opinion on an issue. Typically, an effective essay will contain a minimum of 300 words. Your response will be scored on

  • whether your opinion is supported with reasons and/or examples.
  • grammar,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 30 minutes to plan, write, and revise your essay.

Click on Continue to go on.
